parameters.name: ApiName
parameters.description: The name of the API. The name is used for fuzzy match.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the current page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

*   **RELEASE**
*   **TEST**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-history-apis --group-id 0ccb66aadb5345b78a40f57d192d8aa4 --stage-name RELEASE --api-id a12068f555964ca8a0c9c33288f1e5a7 --api-name getPersonInfo --page-size 10 --page-number 2 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DescribeHistoryApis --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --StageName RELEASE --ApiName getPersonInfo --PageNumber 2 --ApiId a12068f555964ca8a0c9c33288f1e5a7 --GroupId 0ccb66aadb5345b78a40f57d192d8aa4
